sentences.en: I'm forming an exploratory committee to decide whether I should run for president.
sentences.zh: 我正在组建一个探索性委员会，以决定是否参选总统。

sentences.en: An exploratory investigation was required to collect important data regarding the health of the ecosystem.

sentences.en: The company is conducting an exploratory drilling project in the Arctic.
sentences.zh: 这家公司正在北极进行勘探钻探项目。

senses.zh: 探索的，考察的，探索的,“explorative”的变体,试探性
